title: Valid configuration encoding language
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols. The valid-configuration language consists of Boolean strings $y$ for which there exist a Boolean string $x$ and natural numbers $c,s$ such that $y$ is the pair encoding of $x$ and the pair encoding of the binary representations of $c$ and $s$, and there is a configuration $C$ of $N$ on input $x$ that lies in the window of size $s$ and has configuration code $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape symbols
